testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Microsoft Dynamics 365 functional consultant with sales expertise
recommended_experience: Strong business knowledge of sales processes for business-to-customer and business-to-business scenarios. Proficient in configuring Microsoft Power Platform, primarily model-driven apps. Knowledge of Microsoft 365 services and their interactions with Microsoft Dataverse.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: The Microsoft MB-210 Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant exam is officially retired and no longer available for candidates to schedule or take for
editorial.overview: The Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant exam, known as MB-210, was designed to evaluate a candidate's proficiency in configuring user interfaces, managing core sales features, and integrating various sales applications. This exam is now retired, and Microsoft has not named a successor. Candidates should check official Microsoft resources for current certification paths. This reference remains available for historical study of the final published objectives, which included 40 questions and a 100-minute duration for all test takers.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam was intended for functional consultants responsible for configuring, customizing, and expanding Dynamics 365 Sales functionality. It required professional experience in automating and accelerating sales processes to create effective business solutions for diverse organizational needs.
skills_summary: Creating and managing accounts and contacts
Creating and managing leads and opportunities
Creating and managing quotes, orders, and invoices
editorial.preparation_strategy: Since this exam is retired with no successor, do not prepare to sit for it. Focus your efforts on current Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications. Review the final published objectives to understand the core concepts of Dynamics 365 Sales configuration, as these principles remain relevant for general platform knowledge. Consult the official Microsoft certification website to identify active credentials that align with your professional goals and career trajectory.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focused on the technical setup and configuration of the user interface within the Dynamics 365 Sales environment to ensure that sales teams could effectively navigate and utilize the platform features for their daily operations.

This domain covered the management of primary sales entities and the full lifecycle of sales documentation, including the creation and maintenance of accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, quotes, orders, and invoices for various business requirements.

This domain addressed the integration of external sales applications and services with the Dynamics 365 platform to enhance functionality and provide a more cohesive experience for users managing complex sales workflows and data.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: As this exam is retired, it cannot be scheduled or taken. Please visit the official Microsoft certification website to explore currently available exams and follow their specific registration and testing procedures to advance your professional credentials.

faq.question_title: How many questions were on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consisted of 40 questions in total. These questions were designed to test the functional consultant's ability to configure and manage the Dynamics 365 Sales environment effectively during the allotted testing time.

The passing score for the exam was 700 on a scale of 1-1000. Candidates were required to demonstrate a high level of proficiency to meet this standard and earn the associated professional certification.

The exam had a total duration of 100 minutes. This time limit was intended to allow candidates to complete all sections and review their answers before final submission at the authorized testing center.

faq.question_title: What was the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The price for the exam was 165 dollars. This fee covered the registration and administration of the test at authorized testing centers or through online proctoring services for all eligible candidates who registered.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official Microsoft exam guides, certification documentation, and verified facts regarding the retirement status of the MB-210 exam to provide an accurate historical reference for candidates.
